Working other apps

Ultron reads the screen, finds the button, taps it, types and scrolls.

What it is

With Accessibility turned on, Ultron can use any app that Android lets it see. That covers the apps that have no shortcut or voice command of their own.

How it works

  • Reads the screen

    It reads the text and numbers every item it can press, so it can say which one to tap.

  • Taps, types and scrolls

    It taps, types, scrolls and waits for text to appear before it goes on.

  • System buttons

    Back, home, recents, quick settings and screenshots.

  • You stay in control

    It stays off until you grant Android's permission yourself.
